name: kb_combat_rogue
notes: The Turtle knowledge base's Combat list (Combat Envenom daggers): Envenom at one combo point before Slice and Dice, Eviscerate at five, Surprise Attack after the mob dodges and below 80 energy, Sinister Strike as the builder, Blade Flurry on with two or more mobs. Backstab waits for a dagger and for the position behind the mob, which the conditions cannot see; the Adrenaline Rush build, the cancelled Blade Flurry, Vanish's threat reset and the items are named in kb.unexpressed.

priorities.note: The swing is the base every entry waits on: it goes first in the order, as in the Go rotation (rogue_combat).
no_self_aura, not self_aura_missing: the buff lasts under a minute (6 s per combo point), so the under-a-minute rule would spend every combo point on it.

unexpressed.text: Backstab | main hand is a dagger AND behind target
unexpressed.why: positional (behind the target) not in the conditions

unexpressed.text: Sinister Strike | main hand is a sword/axe/mace/fist; never with a dagger main hand (swap weapons instead when you cannot be behind)
unexpressed.why: weapon type not in the conditions

unexpressed.text: Adrenaline Rush build only: keep Slice and Dice + 5-point Rupture (Taste for Blood); Adrenaline Rush right after a 5-point Rupture; Eviscerate only if both buffs have 20+ s left | talents include Adrenaline Rush; no Envenom
unexpressed.why: talents are not a condition: the Adrenaline Rush build only
